_readme: Single source of truth for pricing. Read by the landing page (landing/index.html) and the in-app My Plan card. Later the same shape lives in the Supabase `plans` table (db/schema_v260_plans.sql) so the owner can edit it from admin without a deploy. Change numbers HERE (or in the table), never in code. A limit of null = unlimited, 0 = not included. To add a plan, a limit or a feature: add it here; the UI renders whatever it finds.

billing._upi_id_note: v262: shown in the app's manual upgrade-request flow (pay by UPI, submit the UTR, owner approves in admin.html) until a real gateway (Razorpay/T-106) exists. Set to a real UPI ID (ideally a dedicated Business-profile one, not a personal everyday-spending ID) to activate it; null shows a "being set up" message instead.

xp_discount._note: Discount = cap% x price x min(1, eligible_xp / target_xp). eligible_xp = XP earned in the billing month, counting at most daily_cap per day (so reaching the target needs steady days, not one binge). target_xp ratchets up with the person's own usage: next = clamp(avg of last window months of eligible XP x ratchet, base_target, max_target). XP is never sold for cash and is never spent: level and streak are not reduced by a discount.

invite._note: inviter XP is credited only after the invitee signed in with Google and was engaged on 3 days; monthly cap applies (server-side, already built in v250)
